300.body: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk’s visit to India puts a $10 billion bilateral trade ambition in focus, with defence manufacturing, advanced technology and industrial investment emerging as potential drivers of growth. India-Poland bilateral trade reached $6.36 billion in 2025, up from $5.80 billion in 2024, according to figures published by the Indian Embassy in Warsaw. Trade growth will depend on market access India has a trade surplus with Poland, with Indian exports reaching $4.83 billion in 2025 against imports of $1.53 billion. Bilateral trade totalled $3.20 billion between January and June, including Indian exports of $2.41 billion and imports from Poland of $794 million.

400.title: Poland and Lithuania sign agreement for the Harmony Link interconnector
400.summary: Poland and Lithuania have signed an agreement to advance a new electricity interconnector aimed at strengthening regional energy security, amid growing concerns over Russian hybrid threats to critical infrastructure. Once operational, Harmony Link is expected to increase the combined electricity exchange capacity between Poland and Lithuania to 1,200 megawatts.
400.body: Poland and Lithuania have signed an agreement to advance a new electricity interconnector aimed at strengthening regional energy security, amid growing concerns over Russian hybrid threats to critical infrastructure. It marks a step toward building Harmony Link, a second electricity connection between the two countries. Once operational, Harmony Link is expected to increase the combined electricity exchange capacity between Poland and Lithuania to 1,200 megawatts. Harmony Link is part of the wider infrastructure program supporting that transition, and the investment comes amid a European Union effort to strengthen cross-border energy infrastructure, diversify supplies and protect critical networks against sabotage and other hybrid threats.
